title: Kids' Solid Color Cotton Zip-Up Hoodie, Long Sleeve
intro:
Children's solid-color cotton hoodie with a full front zip, a hood and long sleeves. Check the selected color in the product images.

FIT: Sizes 100–160. Compare the garment bust, length, shoulder and sleeve measurements with a well-fitting hoodie; age and height are guides only. All measurements are in cm; allow the stated 2–3 cm manual measurement difference. Select a color/design and check the available sizes.
